randomization_rule: Initialize each fixed seed separately for each scenario on sorted physical road IDs; same positional permutation across scenarios and across severity levels. No scenario-dependent seed adjustment.
tie_break: Exact floating objective minimum; ties use ascending physical ID of last action in forward recurrence, then predecessor rank. No tolerance-based replacement.

algorithms.forward: two-best distinct sequence subset DP; predecessor-state C
algorithms.small_tests: m1..7 exhaustive permutations with fixed deterministic costs

absolute_metric: Duration-weighted average stage model-implied per-trip minutes; not engineering duration, realized cumulative delay or project cost

optional_OD.percentile: Smallest OD shortest-time value with demand-weighted CDF >= p
optional_OD.method: Dijkstra on archived 5.2 congested open-arc times; no UE call
